title: English Practice Quiz 0702
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: If I were you, I ___ apologise.
questions.explanation: If I were you is followed by would for advice.

questions.question: There isn't ___ milk left.
questions.explanation: Milk is uncountable, so use much in a negative sentence.

questions.question: He decided ___ early.
questions.explanation: Decide is commonly followed by a to-infinitive.

questions.question: This is the woman ___ helped me.
She ___ in this hospital for five years.
questions.explanation: The present perfect can describe a situation continuing to the present.

questions.question: Choose the best word: The road is very ___. There are many cars.
questions.explanation: Crowded means filled with many people or things; it can describe busy roads.

questions.question: ___ I borrow your pen, please?
questions.explanation: May is a polite way to ask permission.

questions.question: You did not hear someone. You say:
questions.explanation: Could you repeat that, please? is a polite request.

questions.question: Read: 'Ravi practises English for twenty minutes every evening.' How long does he practise?
Which question asks for a reason?
